culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hideki Sugimoto. However, the accident turned out to be a murder made to look like an accident. He pretended to struggle with him, so that he could push the victim towards a tarp (he cut the ropes holding it in place) and stabbed him repeatedly with his ballpoint pen to loosen his grip. The marks on the victim's hand indicate this and is what is used to convict the murderer.

summary.en:
Kogoro and Conan are on their way home when they witness a struggle between two men over a backpack. Later, one of the men fell off the building and died.

Location: Train station

Victim: Keisuke Furuta
